It added two new maps, [[Midnight Issue]] and [[Legacy Winter Abyss]]. This update encompassed seven versions, the main v1.80.0 update (released 12 November 2025) and six minor updates, the v1.80.1 (released 12 November 2025), v1.80.1a (released 12 November 2025), v1.80.1b (released 14 November 2025), v1.80.1bc (released 19 November 2025), v1.80.1d (released 26 November 2025) and v1.80.1e (released 26 November 2025). ==Additions== ===Maps=== *[[Midnight Issue]]
